detailZones.title: Bedhead services
detailZones.description: Explore the bedhead rail, medical gas fittings, patient call controls, lights and wall connections.

detailZones.title: Bed and linens
detailZones.description: Inspect the mattress, pillow, sheet, blanket, bed rails and the visible bed upholstery.

detailZones.title: Bed frame and controls
detailZones.description: Follow the bed frame, lift mechanism, wheels, brake pedals and visible adjustment controls.

detailZones.title: Monitor and infusion equipment
detailZones.description: Explore the bedside monitor, equipment trolley, infusion pole, pump, tubing and cable fittings.

detailZones.title: Bedside cabinet and supplies
detailZones.description: Identify the bedside cabinet, drawers, drinking glass, water jug, tissues and adjacent surfaces.

detailZones.title: Privacy and room fittings
detailZones.description: Inspect the privacy curtain, visitor chair, window, ceiling fittings, door and nearby room surfaces.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
